Subject: Private offer accepted — next steps on draw cadence and invoices

Hi Ben,

Thanks for sending over the private offer. BlueWave reviewed the terms with finance and we're ready to move forward, but we need to finalize the monthly draw cadence and confirm where invoices will be routed for payment (we have separate AP contacts per region).

Quick questions from our side:
- Can you confirm whether drawdowns can be scheduled on the 1st of each month versus the 15th?
- Will Redwood or GCP issue the invoice for the Marketplace private offer? If GCP issues the invoice, we need to route it to our marketplace AP alias; if Redwood issues it, we need your billing contact/info.
- We need a short monthly usage report (CSV) that maps consumed tokens to invoice line items for reconciliation. Is that available?

Attaching our PO template and a sample vendor W-9 for your finance team.

Thanks,

Jordan —

Great news, and congrats on getting the internal sign-off. Short answers up front:
- We can support monthly drawdowns on either the 1st or 15th. Default for most private offers is the 1st, but we can schedule a 15th cadence if that aligns with your AR cycle.
- GCP issues the Marketplace invoice for private offers (the charge flows through the Marketplace billing account), but Redwood provides a consolidated monthly statement and per-deal CSV to help with reconciliation.
- We can produce a token-level consumption CSV grouped by offer line item; Marissa (cc'd) handles the per-deal reporting payload.

Marissa / Karthik — Jordan asked about routing the invoice to BlueWave's AP alias if GCP issues it. Can you confirm the exact metadata GCP needs so the invoice shows BlueWave's PO number and the right billing alias? Also, any lead time for getting the monthly CSV configured?

Jordan — I'll loop in our GCP marketplace rep and our channel partner to make sure the PO number mapping and settlement window are covered.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding billing ops details here.

Jordan / BlueWave,

A few operational notes to make sure settlement goes smoothly:
- Because this is a Private Offer, GCP will generate the invoice and route it to the buyer. To make the invoice include BlueWave's PO number and proper AP alias, GCP needs the invoice routing email and the PO number populated in the offer metadata prior to first billing. Please confirm the exact PO string you want — e.g., BW-PO-2026-334.
- If BlueWave prefers Redwood to invoice directly (instead of GCP), we can switch to an MSP billing flow, but that requires an updated SOW and a monthly billing SLA. It's usually slower for signoff.
- The standard settlement window is net 30 from the invoice date; GCP enforces their billing cadence, so preferred draw date (1st vs 15th) affects when charges appear on BlueWave's invoice.
- We will produce a monthly CSV: columns will include date, offer_id, line_item_description, tokens_consumed, effective_rate, invoice_line_reference. We can deliver via secure S3 share or encrypted email; which do you prefer?

Action items:
1) Jordan: confirm PO string and AP routing email (needed before we finalize the offer metadata).
2) Karthik: confirm whether we should request invoice alias routing in the private offer creation form or add it as an additional marketplace metadata change after offer creation.
3) Ben / Vanessa: loop in GCP rep and CloudBridge (partner) to approve the mapping and confirm no additional billing transfer steps are required.

Attachments: GCP_private_offer_summary.xlsx (contains the offer id and mapping fields)

--
Marissa Cole
Finance & Ops, Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.example.com

- PO string: BW-PO-2026-334
- AP routing alias: ap-marketplace-northamerica@bluewave.ai
- We prefer the 1st-of-month draw cadence.
- For the monthly usage CSV, secure S3 share is preferred (we'll provide read-only creds once you share the bucket name).

One additional ask: can Redwood include a short reconciliation section in the monthly statement that explains how credits/adjustments show up versus gross consumption? Our finance team likes a 2–3 sentence mapping per invoice.

If that's all ok, please confirm and we'll send the signed PO via DocuSign.
